nodes.summary: The programme treats a candidate physical distinction only after quotienting gauge, basis, coordinate, and other redundant descriptions. A surviving distinction must then acquire a well-defined relative amplitude and, to explain later observables, a persistent causal record. Nonzero amplitude does not by itself settle actuality, and observability is an evidence condition rather than a definition of existence.

nodes.title: Recursive objectivity and resistance from the world
nodes.summary: Objectivity does not erase the observer; it applies the same evidential burden to the observer's location, preferred branch, and selection rule. Reflective consistency can expose hidden exemptions but cannot establish physics by itself: epistemic weight additionally requires invariance under legitimate redescription and vulnerability to counterexample, intervention, and observation.
